queued.title: Double Concerto in E minor, Op. 88 (violin & viola version)
Lieder und Tänze nach russischen und schwedischen Volksmelodien, Op. 79

notes: No changes needed. Titles, keys, opus numbers, categories and levels are consistent with the anchors: Concerto No. 1 is L7, Scottish Fantasy is L8, and Kol Nidrei at L5 matches its RCM 9 listing. Some durations differ from IMSLP: the Konzertstück is listed at 19 min against IMSLP's 11, and Concerto No. 3 at 38 against 32. These were left alone because recorded performances usually run close to the database figures. Neither queued entry duplicates an existing one: the Double Concerto Op. 88 is a new work, and Op. 79 is a separate collection from the Swedish Dances, Op. 63.
